futures.source: CFTC Commitments of Traders, futures only, read from the CFTC Public Reporting Environment
futures.credit: Invented positions, not CFTC data: a seeded random walk run through the served parser, store and reader.
futures.lag_note: Lagged disclosure, not live positioning: each report states positions as of a Tuesday and is released the following Friday, later in a holiday week.

holdings.source: SEC Form 13F data sets (www.sec.gov), long positions in shares; tickers paired with CUSIPs from the SEC's fails-to-deliver data
holdings.credit: Invented filings, not SEC data: seeded 13F filers and issuers run through the served parser, store and reader.
holdings.lag_note: Lagged disclosure, not live positioning: holdings as of the quarter's end, filed up to 45 days after it; long positions only, from managers with $100 million or more in 13(f) securities.

excluded.reason: no 13F row stored: the SEC's fails-to-deliver files read pair no CUSIP with CRWV, or no 13F filer reports a long position in its shares for 2026-06-30
the SEC's fails-to-deliver files name NBIS 'Not The Same Co Com' and 13F filers name its CUSIP 'Invented Nbis Corp', so the pairing is not settled
